timingDefinition.primaryTotal: Each arm's preparationMs + sum of its40 callbackMs + its single original final whole-canvas R0 readbackMs.

timingDefinition.quantilesUnchanged: Use the existing summarize implementation exactly: median sorted[floor(n*.5)], p95 sorted[floor(n*.95)], max last, sum original values. Do not substitute another percentile definition or round before comparison.
outsidePrimaryTotal: PNG encoding/export, callback proof/hash/serialization, reporting/image callbacks and batch-eight rAF yields remain separate as in the original protocol.
The final one15-second event-driven owned cleanup wait and final resource/owner resnapshot occur after all preparation/callback/readback timings and are reported separately.

Native late retirement callbacks can still run during later arm preparation/measurement, as in the existing harness. Their observed interference is not removed, compensated or reclassified to manufacture a speedup.
timingDefinition.validity: All timing values must be finite/nonnegative and faster-original primary total must be positive. Preserve raw preparation, first/all40/steady30, readback, export, pass wall and yield intervals.
timingDefinition.limits: This primary total is a declared renderer-call cost metric, not whole-page elapsed work. It excludes HUD, audio, persistence and scheduling gaps. CPU call wall can include synchronous waits; it is not GPU execution time, presented FPS or peak RAM/VRAM. Shared URL decode/driver caches and OS variation remain; fresh owned contexts do not imply globally cold caches.

cleanupFailurePolicy.deadline: One overall15000ms deadline starts at cleanup wait, with no polling. Synchronous retirement past the clock deadline also fails even when the timer has not dispatched.
cleanupFailurePolicy.lateWork: Registered producer rejection can still retire successfully. Async retirement and newly registered followers must finish before completion. Capacity/cross-owner/registration failure blocks acceptance and preserves caller fallback best-effort cleanup.
cleanupFailurePolicy.timeout: Finalize an independent immutable failed cleanup report. Keep pending labels/status/elapsed/counters and final resource resnapshot. Late callbacks may continue best-effort, but later completion never rewrites the failed result into a pass.
cleanupFailurePolicy.noPartialSuccess: Any native setup failure, normal combat ending early, read failure, unsupported/fallback mode, owner mutation, missing arm/sample/usage, pixel/state mismatch or cleanup failure keeps accepted/adopted false. Preserve the primary error and secondary cleanup evidence.

priorEvidenceMustRemain.oldCost: qa/player-deferred-read-20261018/cost-not-executed.json records0 combat runs and an original initial-load/control failure. It supplies no candidate performance baseline.
priorEvidenceMustRemain.privateQuality: Previous actual40 held-pose original/candidate/original comparisons had body/colour/metadata zero differences, but used extra quality renders/reads. Their timings cannot be reused as COST evidence.
priorEvidenceMustRemain.wholeFailure: Previous strict whole-canvas AB903/max67, AA1322575/max69 and BA1322461/max60 failures remain immutable. Independent PNG analysis reproduced582443 changed AA pixels. The unresolved cause is not attributed to or declared fixed by this cleanup extension.
priorEvidenceMustRemain.exceptionScope: Only original-owned successful native Canvas paths are compared. Deferred read failures can follow more armed/compositor work; universal exceptional side-effect ordering and mutated global accessors/render-graph callbacks remain outside scope.

runAndDecisionPolicy.beforeBrowser: Root freezes source, passes meaningful focused legacy/new-mode contracts and runs the existing whole suite once. Preserve any original budget/verify failures; do not change thresholds or rerun to seek favorable numbers.
runAndDecisionPolicy.actualRun: One fresh native IAB8851-memory A/B/A bracket with no concurrent CPU/tests/profile/GPU job. Preserve all raw JSON, first/steady/max samples, PNGs, console and source/cleanup evidence, including bad results and incomplete setup.
runAndDecisionPolicy.onFailure: Keep QA candidate OFF/default product unchanged. No repeat to find clean pixels or fast costs, no changed criteria, no new paid assets, publication or store action.
runAndDecisionPolicy.onPass: A passing diagnostic is not automatic product adoption, no-lag completion, full app validation, presented FPS or peak-memory evidence. Any later adoption requires a separate explicit root task.
